title: Find the lines that two lists share, or that only one of them has
summary: Compare two lists line by line and print the lines present in both, or the lines present only in the first list. Good for finding users who are in two lists or items that are missing from one.

aliases.text: what lines are only in file1
найти общие строки в двух файлах
что есть только в одном из списков linux
сравнить два списка и найти отсутствующие

steps.explain: comm compares two sorted lists in three columns: only in the first, only in the second, and in both. -1 and -2 hide the first two columns, so only lines in both remain. comm needs sorted input, so sort runs first.
steps.expect: Only the lines that appear in both files, one per line.

alternatives.explain: join matches lines by their first word instead. Use it when each line starts with an ID followed by more columns. Both files must be sorted on that first word.

steps.explain: Show the lines that are only in the first list. -2 and -3 hide the columns for the second list and for the lines in both.
steps.expect: Lines that exist in FILE_A but are missing from FILE_B.
